shell.boqItemsOfThisSection: BOQ items of this section (green rows come from this step)
shell.showTheItemsSentTo: Show the items sent to the BOQ (for checking)
shell.resetThisStepToIts: Reset this step to its default values?
shell.restoreTheSampleValuesFrom: Restore the sample values from the template?

brick.lengthGableBaseHeightGable: Length = gable base, height = gable apex. The system takes half of it.
brick.doorsAndWindowsExceedThe: Doors and windows exceed the wall area. Check the wall length/height, or the installed wall of the doors and windows.
brick.theSystemDeductsThemFrom: The system deducts them from the wall with the same wall part and brick type.
brick.thereAreNoDoorsAnd: There are no doors and windows yet, so no openings are deducted from the walls.
brick.noWallsYetCheckThe: No walls yet. Check the floor plan and elevations, then add the walls group by group (e.g. exterior brick walls). You can type each run joined, e.g. 9.5+7+2.
brick.addWallsForDoorsAnd: Add walls for doors and windows ({v} groups)
brick.someDoorsAndWindowsHave: Some doors and windows have no wall of the same type yet (not deducted)
brick.addThisWallTypeOr: Add this wall type, or correct the wall of the doors and windows in the previous step.
brick.theMasonryAreaAfterDeducting: The masonry area (after deducting doors and windows) carries over to the plastering step automatically.
brick.openingsWithoutAMatchingWall: Openings without a matching wall (not deducted)
brick.wallAreaLengthHeightRectangle: Wall area = length × height (rectangle) or ½ × length × height (triangle, e.g. gable wall)
brick.openingAreaTheDoorAnd: Opening area = the door and window area whose wall part + brick + thickness match this row (from the door and window table). If several rows match, the openings are deducted once, split in proportion to the wall areas.
brick.thereIsNoDoorAnd: There is no door and window table yet, so opening areas are not deducted.
brick.totalWallAreaOpeningArea: Total = wall area − opening area → sent to BOQ section 17 by brick type × thickness, and passed to the plastering work by wall part.
brick.brickMasonryAreaSummarySent: Brick masonry area summary (sent to BOQ section 17)
brick.tieColumnsAndLintelsIncluded: Tie columns and lintels (included in the wall area)
brick.exteriorWallOfTheHouse: Exterior wall of the house (plastered 1 side inside, 1 side outside)
brick.partitionWallInsideTheHouse: Partition wall inside the house (plastered on both inner sides)
brick.wallOutsideTheHouseE: Wall outside the house, e.g. laundry area walls, fences (plastered on both outer sides)
brick.specialWallOfTheHouse: Special wall of the house, e.g. the triangular gable wall under the roof

ceiling.leaveBlankForAFlat: Leave blank for a flat ceiling
ceiling.noRoomsYetOpenThe: No rooms yet. Open the ceiling plan and add the rooms one by one (room name, ceiling type, width × length).
ceiling.anLShapedRoomIs: An L-shaped room is split into 2 cards. For similar rooms press "Duplicate" and change only the size.
ceiling.passedOnToThePainting: Passed on to the painting step:
ceiling.thePaintedCeilingAreaPasses: The painted ceiling area passes to the painting step automatically.
ceiling.slopedCeilingEGA: Sloped ceiling (e.g. a balcony ceiling under the roof): total = width × length ÷ cos(degrees). The template sample uses
ceiling.forBalconies12Enter: ° for balconies 1–2 (enter 0 for a flat ceiling)
ceiling.symbolsC1C4PoolThe: Symbols C1–C4 pool the quantities into BOQ section 19. "Paint work" pools the painted ceiling areas for the painting program.
ceiling.ceilingAreaSummarySentTo: Ceiling area summary (sent to BOQ section 19)
ceiling.ceilingPaintAreaSummarySent: Ceiling paint area summary (sent to the painting program)

column.noColumnsYetCheckThe: No columns yet. Check the column plan and column details, then add them type by type (C1, C2 …) with the number of columns.
column.fromTheTopOfThe: From the top of the footing to the underside of the upper beam
column.concreteNumberOfColumnsWidth: Concrete = number of columns × width × length × height · Formwork = number of columns × 2 × (width + length) × height
column.verticalBarsNumberOfColumns: Vertical bars = number of columns × number of bars × column height
column.stirrupsRoundUpHeightSpacing: Stirrups = round up (height ÷ spacing) stirrups per column × 2 × (width + length)
column.columnReinforcementIsCountedIn: Column reinforcement is counted in the reinforcement work, by bar size, including wastage and tie wire.
column.heightMIsTypedManually: Height (m) is typed manually and is not linked to the footing/pedestal. Template sample = 0.55 + 3.5 = 4.05 m.
column.mainReinforcementLengthBarColumn: Main reinforcement: length / bar = column height; total length = number of columns × length / bar × number of bars
column.stirrupsNumberRoundUpHeight: Stirrups: number = round up (height ÷ spacing); length / bar = 2 × (width + length)
column.formworkNumberOfColumns2: Formwork = number of columns × 2 × (width + length) × height; concrete = number of columns × width × length × height → BOQ 11
column.columnReinforcementIsSentTo: Column reinforcement is sent to BOQ section 6, item 7) Reinforcement - ***First-floor columns (one row per bar size + 3% tie wire)

demolition.rateLabourBasicToolsInitial: Rate = labour + basic tools + initial expenses per unit
demolition.bahtSentToTheBoq: baht, sent to the BOQ row "Demolition work" (labour column, 1 lump sum)
demolition.noDemolitionItemsYetThe: No demolition items yet. The BOQ row "Demolition work" is 0 (no demolition work).
demolition.fillInOnlyTheWork: Fill in only the work that really exists. The demolition cost per unit includes labour, tools and initial expenses.
demolition.missingtextThisItemStillCounts: {missingText} — this item still counts as 0 baht
demolition.eGDemolishTheOld: e.g. demolish the old septic tank
demolition.combinedAs1LumpSum: Combined as 1 lump sum in the BOQ
demolition.noDemolitionWorkYetIf: No demolition work yet. If the land is vacant with nothing to demolish, press "Not in this project" below.

doorWindow.aLightWallDoesNot: A light wall does not deduct openings in the brick masonry step
doorWindow.noDoorsYetCheckThe: No doors yet. Check the door schedule in the drawings (D1, D2 …) and add them type by type: size, leaf type and number.
doorWindow.noWindowsYetCheckThe: No windows yet. Check the window schedule in the drawings (W1, W2 …) and add them type by type.
doorWindow.codeItemAsInThe: Code - item (as in the drawing schedule)
doorWindow.installedInWallAndWall: "Installed in wall" and "Wall type" are used to deduct the door and window areas from the walls in the brick masonry step. Choose the wall they are installed in.
doorWindow.defaultPricesAluminiumIsPriced: Default prices: aluminium is priced by leaf area (
doorWindow.bahtSetYouCanChange: baht/set. You can change them in the price section below.
doorWindow.greenCellsDefaultPriceType: Green cells = default price; type over them, clear the value to return to the default. Aluminium: sliding/fixed-light
doorWindow.theOpeningAreaIsDeducted: The opening area is deducted from the walls in the brick masonry step automatically.
doorWindow.openingAreaBrickMasonryDeducted: Opening area → Brick masonry (deducted from the wall area)
doorWindow.woodenDoorFramesAllWooden: Wooden door frames (all wooden leaves) → BOQ 18 item 3)
doorWindow.doorAndWindowQuantityTable: : Door and window quantity table, opening area
doorWindow.areaPerLeafWidthHeight: Area per leaf = width × height; total = area per leaf × number → deducted from the brick masonry by matching wall part / brick / thickness
doorWindow.boq241RowPer: → BOQ 24 (1 row per item): material per set = width × height × rate (
doorWindow.boq301RowPer: → BOQ 30 (1 row per item): default 4,000 / 800 baht per set; wooden doors carry the note “
doorWindow.greenCellsDefaultPriceType2: Green cells = default price; type over them, clear the value to return to the default
doorWindow.woodenDoorFramesBoq18: Wooden door frames (BOQ 18 item 3) = total number of wooden leaves including wooden windows (as the system calculates it)
doorWindow.theBrickLightWallIs: The brick “Light wall” is not in the brick masonry sheet, so its openings are not deducted.

electricalCable.theCircuitsAndCableRuns: The circuits and cable runs come from the conduit step. Add circuits in that step first.
electricalCable.cableSizeNotSelectedYet: Cable size not selected yet — {v} m of cable is not priced yet
electricalCable.numberOfWiresNotSelected: Number of wires not selected yet — {v} m of cable is not priced yet
electricalCable.thisCircuitHasNoConduit: This circuit has no conduit length yet
electricalCable.circuitAndTheCableRun: circuit and the cable run of each circuit. Rename or add circuits in that step.
electricalCable.theSystemPicksTheCable: The system picks the cable size by circuit type. Check it against the electrical diagram (lighting: main 2.5 / to luminaire 1.5 sq.mm, 2 wires · sockets: 4 / 2.5 sq.mm, 3 wires · water heater, air conditioner, water pump: 4 sq.mm, 3 wires)
electricalCable.circuitsWithoutACableSize: circuits without a cable size yet
electricalCable.n6SqMmCableHas: 6 sq.mm cable has no price item yet, so it is not priced.
electricalCable.theCircuitsCbSizeAnd: The circuits, CB size and cable lengths come from the
electricalCable.addDeleteRenameCircuitsThere: (add/delete/rename circuits there): branch circuit cable length = horizontal + vertical (branch circuit), to equipment = horizontal + vertical (to equipment)
electricalCable.eachThwSizeBranchCircuit: Each THW size = branch circuit cable length × number of wires (if that size is selected) + equipment cable length × number of wires (if that size is selected)
electricalCable.thw6HasNoRow: THW #6 has no row in the BOQ (as the system calculates it). Lengths chosen as THW 6 are not priced.
electricalCable.mOfCableWithNo: m of cable with no cable size or number of wires selected, so it is not counted in any THW cell.
electricalCable.electricalCableLengthSummarySent: Electrical cable length summary (sent to BOQ section 18)

electricalEquipment.outdoorWetPointsDoNot: Outdoor / wet points. Do not count them again in the general sockets.

electricalPipe.circuitNameAsInThe: Circuit name (as in the load schedule)
electricalPipe.howToFillIn1: How to fill in (1 card = 1 circuit = 1 breaker in the panel)
electricalPipe.measureAlongTheConduitAbove: : measure along the conduit above the ceiling, from the panel through every point of the circuit (see the electrical plan)
electricalPipe.conduitBranchingFromTheMain: : conduit branching from the main run to each luminaire (lighting circuits). Leave blank if none.
electricalPipe.countTheSwitchesLightingCircuit: : count the switches (lighting circuit) or the sockets (socket circuit). The system calculates the vertical conduit by itself.
electricalPipe.exampleLightingForBedroomBathroom: Example: lighting for bedroom + bathroom: main run conduit 22.4 m, branch conduit to luminaires 25.6 m, 7 switch points → wall drops 7 × 2.3 = 16.1 m + conduit at the panel 1.5 m = total 65.6 m
electricalPipe.checkTheLoadScheduleOr: Check the load schedule or the electrical plan, then add the circuits one by one by type. The system sets the breaker, vertical run and cable size for you.
electricalPipe.verticalConduitRunAndConduit: Vertical conduit run and conduit type
electricalPipe.verticalConduitAtThePanel: Vertical conduit at the panel / to the equipment (m)
electricalPipe.verticalConduitAtThePanel2: Vertical conduit at the panel 1.5 m for every circuit + drop to the equipment: water heater 1.5, bedroom air conditioner 0.9, living/dining room air conditioner 0.3, water pump 2.9 m
electricalPipe.dropPerPointSwitchesAnd: Drop per point: switches and sockets above the counter 2.3 m, sockets 3.2 m · total wall drops = number of points × drop per point (can be typed over)
electricalPipe.allCircuitsArePricedAs: All circuits are priced as PVC 1/2" conduit
electricalPipe.totalMHorizontalBranchCircuit: Total (m) = horizontal (branch circuit + to equipment) + vertical (branch circuit + to equipment)
electricalPipe.verticalToEquipmentInThe: Vertical to equipment in the template sample values = number of points × drop height (lighting / kitchen sockets 2.3 m, sockets 3.2 m), e.g. 7 × 2.3 = 16.10 · vertical branch circuit = 1.5 + rise to the equipment (water heater 1.5, bedroom air conditioner 0.9, living/dining air conditioner 0.3, water pump 2.9)
electricalPipe.cbSizeAndConduitType: CB size and conduit type are reference data. All circuits are pooled into the single BOQ row "Electrical conduit, PVC 1/2" conduit" (as the system calculates it).
electricalPipe.thisCircuitListIsShared: This circuit list is shared with the
electricalPipe.cableLengthBranchCircuitHorizontal: — cable length: branch circuit = horizontal + vertical (branch circuit), to equipment = horizontal + vertical (to equipment)
electricalPipe.electricalConduitLengthSummarySent: Electrical conduit length summary (sent to BOQ section 17)
electricalPipe.someCircuitsAreNotPvc: Some circuits are not PVC 1/2" conduit. The system pools every conduit type into the same BOQ row at the 1/2" conduit price.

fill.eGFillSoilFill: e.g. fill soil, fill sand, supplied by the client
fill.fillMaterialIfAnyGoes: Fill material (if any) goes in the remark. This text appears in the remark cell of the BOQ row "Fill soil (per spec) + compaction". Quantity
fill.cuMGoesIntoThe: cu.m goes into the quantity cell of the same row (the BOQ adds its own allowance % on top, default 10%).
fill.requiredLevelMinusTheExisting: Required level minus the existing ground level
fill.areaVSqMHeight: Area {v} sq.m × height {v2} m + settlement allowance {v3}%
fill.enterTheWidthLengthAnd: Enter the width, length and fill height and the system calculates the soil quantity. If no fill is needed, press "Not in this project" below.

floorTile.copiedVRoomsSkippedCheck: Copied {v} rooms{skipped}. Check the floor types again.
floorTile.copyRoomsFromTheCeiling: Copy rooms from the ceiling ({v} rooms)
floorTile.bathroomsAreEnteredInThe: Bathrooms are entered in the bathroom tile step; they would be counted twice here.
floorTile.noRoomsYetOpenThe: No rooms yet. Open the floor plan and add the rooms one by one (room name, floor type, width × length).
floorTile.doNotEnterBathroomsHere: Do not enter bathrooms here. There is a separate bathroom tile step.
floorTile.anLShapedRoomIs: An L-shaped room is split into 2 cards · Stairs: width = stair width, length = tread + riser
floorTile.templateSampleValuesStairs1: Template sample values, stairs (1)–(3): length = 0.9 + 0.45 = 1.35 m
floorTile.symbolsF1F3F4Pool: Symbols F1 / F3 / F4 pool the quantities into BOQ section 20 (bathrooms are in the bathroom tile program)
floorTile.floorTileAreaSummarySent: Floor tile area summary (sent to BOQ section 20)

footing.numberOfFootingsOfThis: Number of footings of this type
footing.theExcavationIsShallowerThan: The excavation is shallower than the footing + sand + lean concrete. Check the excavation depth again.
footing.noFootingsYetOpenThe: No footings yet. Open the footing plan to see how many types there are (F1, F2 …) and add them one by one.
footing.groundLevelToTheBottom: Ground level to the bottom of the pit, including sand and lean concrete
footing.layersUnderThePitBottom: Layers under the pit bottom, footing {v}
footing.excavationWorkingSpaceAroundThe: Excavation working space around the footing, each side
footing.shortLongBarsAreAs: Short/long bars are as long as the footing + bent up both ends by the footing thickness · ring bars are as long as the footing perimeter
footing.backfillVCuMThe: Backfill {v} cu.m. The pedestal concrete is deducted automatically once the pedestal step is filled in.
footing.sentToTheStructuralMaterial: Sent to the structural material summary table (Footing sheet)
footing.excavatedSoilCoarseSandLean: Excavated soil / coarse sand / lean concrete use the pit size (width + 0.40 + 0.40) × (length + 0.40 + 0.40), with 0.40 m working space on each side
footing.mainReinforcementLengthPerBar: Main reinforcement length per bar = width (or length) + 2 × depth (bent up at both ends) · ring bars = 2 × width + 2 × length
footing.formworkNumberPerimeterDepthSides: Formwork = number × perimeter × depth (sides) · concrete = number × width × length × depth
footing.backfillExcavatedSoilCoarseSand: Backfill = excavated soil − coarse sand − lean concrete − footing concrete − the concrete of the pedestals standing on that footing (from the

groundBeam.noGroundBeamsYetOpen: No ground beams yet. Open the ground beam plan to see how many types there are, then add them one by one with the total length of all spans.
groundBeam.addTheFirstGroundBeam: Add the first ground beam type
groundBeam.addUpAllSpansOf: Add up all spans of this beam type
groundBeam.addTheNextGroundBeam: Add the next ground beam type
groundBeam.leanConcreteUnderTheBeam: Lean concrete under the beam, thickness
groundBeam.mainReinforcementIsCountedOver: Main reinforcement is counted over the full beam length, excluding lap and bend lengths
groundBeam.numberOfStirrupsBeamLength: Number of stirrups = beam length ÷ spacing (rounded up) · formwork counts both sides of the beam (the beam bottom sits on lean concrete)
groundBeam.theBackfillOfThisSection: The backfill of this section comes from the footing and pedestal steps
groundBeam.n1Row1BeamLine: 1 row = 1 beam line · main reinforcement length = number of bars × beam length (excluding lap/bend, as the system calculates it)
groundBeam.numberOfStirrupsRoundUp: Number of stirrups = round up (length ÷ spacing) · stirrup length / bar = 2 × (width + depth)
groundBeam.formwork2Sides2Depth: Formwork = 2 sides (2 × depth × length). The beam bottom sits on lean concrete.
groundBeam.sentToBoqSection8: Sent to BOQ section 8: lean concrete
groundBeam.cuMReinforcementBySize: cu.m, reinforcement by size + 3% tie wire, formwork
groundBeam.sqMBattensNailsAre: sq.m (battens/nails are counted in the BOQ), structural concrete
groundBeam.backfill81IsCalculated: Backfill (8.1) is calculated from the footing program · precast slab end-lock bars (8.4) come from the precast slab program

landInspection.noteThisPriceIsA: Note: this price is a preliminary sample. You can adjust the number / unit / price per unit to match the real area. Amount
landInspection.bahtSentToTheBoq: baht, sent to the BOQ row "Land inspection fee" (labour column, 1 lump sum)
landInspection.inspectTheLandBeforeStarting: Inspect the land before starting work
landInspection.noExpenseItemsYetE: No expense items yet, e.g. inspection labour, travel, accommodation

landInspection.pricePerUnitAndAdditional: Price per unit and additional items

layout.noteFillInTheYellow: Note: fill in the yellow cells only
layout.quantityBeforeAllowanceBasePer: Quantity before allowance = base per layout × number of layouts + fixed base · order quantity = round up(quantity before allowance × (1 + allowance)) · total price = order quantity × price per unit
layout.totalMaterialsPerTheCalculation: Total materials per the calculation list
layout.thisItemIsNotSent: This item is not sent to the BOQ automatically: the BOQ row "Layout / staking" uses the default price of the template (material 4,000 / labour 1,500 baht), which can be changed on the BOQ page.
layout.countTheTimberLayoutPoints: Count the timber layout points along the column lines / grid lines around the building.
layout.normallyEqualToTheNumber: Normally equal to the number of piles
layout.enterTheNumberOfLayout: Enter the number of layout points and stakes and the system calculates the timber to order.
layout.bahtAlreadyIncludedInThe: baht, already included in the project price (adjustable on the BOQ page)

loadCenter.bathroomWaterHeaterAndOutdoor: Bathroom, water heater and outdoor circuits
loadCenter.circuitsAlreadyOnAnElcb: Circuits already on an ELCB are not counted again
loadCenter.fromTheElectricMeterTo: From the electric meter to the control panel
loadCenter.fromTheControlPanelTo: From the control panel to the ground rod

misc.youCanTypeTheName: You can type the name of other items that are not in the list. Enter the unit, material and labour price per unit yourself (no price = 0).
misc.railingEnterTheTotalLength: Railing: enter the total length in metres · other work such as awnings or house number signs: type the item name and enter the unit and price

paint.matchesTheValueInThe: Matches the value in the sheet
paint.paintedAreaFromThePrevious: Painted area from the previous steps
paint.noNeedToFillIn: No need to fill in. Check that it is complete; if an item is missing but the drawings have it, go back and fill it in that step.
paint.sampleValueNoDataFrom: Sample value (no data from the step
paint.ifTheDrawingsHaveIt: If the drawings have it, fill it in the step
paint.thePreviousStepsHaveValues: The previous steps have values you can use for
paint.itemsTheOldAndNew: items. The old and new values are shown under each field.
paint.useAllValuesFromThe: Use all values from the previous steps
paint.usingTheValuesFromThe: Using the values from the previous steps
paint.paintingOfSlatWallsAnd: Painting of slat walls and wall mouldings: none (
paint.girthWidthMouldingFace2: Girth width = moulding face + 2 × thickness (moulding 0.3 × 0.1 → 0.5 m, moulding 0.1 × 0.1 → 0.3 m)

paint.ceilingSheetPaintingWorkCeiling: Ceiling sheet — painting work "Ceiling paint - exterior"
paint.ceilingSheetPaintingWorkCeiling2: Ceiling sheet — painting work "Ceiling paint - interior"
paint.ceilingSheetPaintingWorkCeiling3: Ceiling sheet — painting work "Ceiling paint - wood slats"

paint.lengthFromTheWallDecoration: Length from the wall decoration sheet

pedestal.theFootingStepIsMarked: The footing step is marked "Not in this project"
pedestal.pedestalsStandOnFootingsFill: — Pedestals stand on footings. Fill in each footing type in the footing step first, then come back to this step.

pedestal.fromTheTopOfThe: From the top of the footing to the ground beam
pedestal.backfillAroundTheFootingsV: Backfill around the footings {v} cu.m (footing and pedestal concrete already deducted)

pedestal.standingOnFootingTheRow: Standing on footing = the row in the

piles.pilesFromTheFootingPlan: Piles (from the footing plan / drawing schedule)
piles.countFromTheFootingPlan: Count from the footing plan (all footings together)
piles.aLumpSumPriceNeeds: — A lump-sum price needs the full pile details
piles.lumpSumPricePerPile: Lump-sum price per pile (pile cost + driving cost)
piles.pileTypeAndSectionNot: Pile type and section not selected yet
piles.pilesIsCalculatedAutomaticallyAnd: piles is calculated automatically and included in the value of this step

piles.pileHeadCutting6Footing: Pile head cutting (6. Footing work) — uses the number of piles

plaster.concreteColumnAndBeamSurfaces: Concrete column and beam surfaces that need plastering in addition to the brick walls (leave blank if none)
plaster.thisWallIsNotIn: This wall is not in the brick masonry step
plaster.noBrickWallsYetThe: No brick walls yet. The plaster area comes from the walls in the brick masonry step (after deducting doors and windows). Fill in the walls in the brick masonry step first and the system calculates the plaster area automatically.
plaster.usesTheMasonryWallArea: Uses the masonry wall area of
plaster.wallPartsAfterDeductingDoors: wall parts (after deducting doors and windows). No need to enter it again.
plaster.thePlasteredSidesArePreset: The plastered sides are preset for typical work.
plaster.theExteriorInteriorPlasterAreas: The exterior/interior plaster areas carry over to the painting step automatically.

precastSlab.noPrecastSlabsYetCheck: No precast slabs yet. Check the floor plan (PS) and add the spans one by one (width × length).
precastSlab.slabEndLockBarsAnd: Slab end-lock bars and topping concrete

precastSlab.cuMEndLockBars: cu.m · end-lock bars are sent to section 8 (ground beam work)

roofBeam.addAllSpansOfBeams: Add all spans of beams of this size
roofBeam.concreteWidthDepthLengthFormwork: Concrete = width × depth × length · formwork = 2 sides (2 × depth × length) + beam bottom (width × length)
roofBeam.coreBarsNumberOfBars: Core bars = number of bars × length · stirrups = round up (length ÷ spacing) stirrups × 2 × (width + depth)
roofBeam.reinforcementIsCountedBySize: Reinforcement is counted by size, including wastage and tie wire
roofBeam.numberOfStirrupsRoundUp: Number of stirrups = round up(length ÷ spacing) · stirrup length/bar = 2 × (width + depth) · props = round up(length ÷ 0.6) pcs
roofBeam.formwork2DepthLengthWidth: Formwork = 2 × depth × length + width × length (2 sides + beam bottom)
roofBeam.reinforcementIsSentToThe: Reinforcement is sent to the BOQ by size with the allowance % per size (RB6 6%, RB9 9%, DB12–DB20 12%) and 3% tie wire
